text:
ana-security: Alert: unusual signing activity from internal SSH CA (ca-ssh-01). ~85 certs in ~15m. Treat as suspected compromise and follow emergency runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ssh-ca-incident
sec-bot: :rotating_light: Detector ca-signature-rate fired (evt=ca-2402203344). Baseline 0.6/min, observed 5.7/min. IDS logged.
lena-sre: Oncall. I'll stop the signing endpoint now and schedule a 30m maintenance window. Expect internal SSH interruptions.
mike-eng: Scope check: which services rely on this CA? tagging: bastion, deploy-runners, infra-hosts, ci-workers.
ana-security: (edit) ana-security: containment steps: 1) disable signing, 2) export issued serials, 3) publish temporary CRL to s3://redwood-ssh-crl/incident-2402, 4) create new HSM key and update CA metadata, 5) revoke and reissue short-ttl certs.
lena-sre: Commands to gather evidence and stop service: `systemctl stop ssh-ca.service || pkill -f ssh-ca` then `grep -o "serial=[0-9a-fA-F]\+" /var/log/ssh-ca/audit.log | sed 's/serial=//' | sort -u > /tmp/issued_serials.txt`.
mike-eng: I'll pause deploy pipelines and inform product and infra.
sec-bot: Reminder: SEC-KEY-ROT-2 requires legal & exec notification if compromise confirmed. Use incident ticket TKT-INC-240220-SSHCA for updates.
lena-sre: Live checklist updated in ticket. HSM vendor oncall engaged. Next update in ~20m.
ana-security: Thanks team. Keep comms in incident channel; avoid posting serials publicly. Postmortem to follow. :lock:
